title: Beyond Best-of-$k$: Prior-Consistent DAPS for Ambiguous Nonlinear Inverse Problems
title_zh: 超越Best-of-k：面向歧义非线性逆问题的一致先验DAPS

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models have become strong priors for solving inverse problems. However, nonlinear inverse problems such as phase retrieval remain challenging when multiple measurement-consistent solutions are distinguishable only by the prior; we call such measurements ambiguous. Existing diffusion-based samplers rely on local approximations during reconstruction. For an ambiguous measurement, these approximations can allow measurement guidance to favor a measurement-consistent mode that is close to a prior-supported mode but is itself not supported by the prior. Evaluation often masks this type of failure by reporting the best-of- k k runs, where the best is selected by comparison to the ground truth. We introduce Prior-Consistent DAPS (PC-DAPS), a variant of Decoupled Annealing Posterior Sampling (DAPS) designed to address this failure case by maintaining multiple candidate solutions within a single sampling run. As annealing noise decreases, PC-DAPS prunes and replaces weaker candidates according to their prior consistency, without any ground-truth access. PC-DAPS reduces the incidence of prior-inconsistent samples and improves sample quality on nonlinear inverse problems while preserving sample quality and diversity on linear inverse problems. † †\dagger † †\dagger † \dagger Code: https://github.com/voilalab/PC-DAPS ; project website: PC-DAPS .

paragraphs.en: Inverse problems arise across science and engineering whenever an unknown signal must be recovered from indirect measurements, including image restoration ( Bertero et al., 2021 ) , medical imaging ( Song et al., 2022 ) , and astronomical imaging ( Event Horizon Telescope Collaboration, 2019 ) . Given an observed measurement y y generated through a known but potentially noisy measurement process, the goal of the inverse problem is to recover the original signal x x . For underdetermined problems, in which many different signals x x may give rise to the same measurement y y , Bayesian imaging defines the posterior distribution as p ⁡ ( x ∣ y ) ∝ p ⁡ ( y ∣ x ) ​ p ​ ( x ) p(x\mid y)\propto p(y\mid x)p(x) , where the likelihood p ⁡ ( y ∣ x ) p(y\mid x) captures measurement consistency of a candidate image x x and the prior p ⁡ ( x ) p(x) captures which candidate reconstructions are plausible natural signals. The goal of posterior sampling is thus to generate candidate reconstructions that are simultaneously consistent with the measurement and the prior.

paragraphs.en: In Fourier phase retrieval, for example, multiple images can produce identical Fourier magnitude measurements ( Fienup, 1982 ) . These measurement-equivalent solutions therefore have the same likelihood, but can have very different posterior probabilities depending on their consistency with the image prior. In particular, we observe that existing phase-retrieval solvers applied to face images sometimes return a rotated or color-inverted face that is consistent with the measurement but implausible under a natural-image prior concentrated on upright faces. The challenge is therefore not simply to find measurement-consistent reconstructions, but to sample the measurement-consistent solutions supported by the prior.

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models provide strong image priors for posterior sampling ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2021 ) . At each noise level, a diffusion model implicitly defines a denoiser that maps a noisy sample x t x_{t} to an estimate of the corresponding clean image; this diffusion denoiser can be used to incorporate the prior p ⁡ ( x ) p(x) during posterior sampling. Diffusion-based inverse solvers apply this prior information along a sampling trajectory , i.e., the sequence of intermediate states that evolves from a noisy sample toward a reconstruction. Existing methods primarily either tilt the unconditional reverse diffusion process using an approximate likelihood gradient ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Chung et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Boys et al., 2024 ) or alternate prior and measurement updates across noise levels ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Xu and Chi, 2024 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Ahmed and Makin, 2026 ) . In these methods, the prior information available at each noise level is represented through a local denoising approximation centered on a single clean-image estimate, rather than explicitly maintaining multiple competing prior modes at intermediate timesteps.

paragraphs.en: When the measurement is ambiguous, as in the case of phase retrieval and other underdetermined inverse problems, following a sampling trajectory can lead to premature mode selection . At high noise levels, multiple prior modes may remain plausible, but the trajectory can only move towards one of them. Once a trajectory selects a particular prior mode, subsequent refinement primarily improves measurement consistency in the local neighborhood of that mode rather than considering more distant alternatives. This becomes problematic when (i) the selected prior mode is not consistent with the measurement, and (ii) its nearest measurement-consistent mode is not supported by the prior. Trajectory-based samplers can prematurely commit to this pair of modes, ultimately resulting in hallucinatory sampled reconstructions that are not supported by the true posterior or even the true prior. Best-of- k k evaluation partially masks this issue by generating multiple independent reconstructions and selecting the one closest to the ground truth ( Chung et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . However, this selection uses information unavailable at test time and does not ensure that the produced samples are prior-consistent. Particle-based approaches maintain multiple candidates at intermediate timesteps ( Cardoso et al., 2024 ; Dou and Song, 2024 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) , but have primarily focused on linear inverse problems and particle diversity rather than prior-consistent sampling.
paragraphs.zh: 当测量存在歧义时，例如相位恢复和其他欠定逆问题，沿单一采样轨迹推进可能导致过早的模式选择。 在高噪声水平下，多个先验模式可能仍然合理，但轨迹只能向其中一个移动。 一旦轨迹选定了某个特定的先验模式，后续的精细化主要是在该模式的局部邻域内提升与测量的一致性，而不再考虑更远的备选模式。 当以下情况同时出现时就会产生问题：(i) 被选中的先验模式与测量不一致，(ii) 其最近的一个与测量一致的模式又得不到先验的支持。 基于轨迹的采样器可能过早地锁定这样一对模式，最终产生不被真实后验甚至真实先验支持的幻觉式采样重建结果。 Best-of- k k 评估通过生成多个独立的重建结果并选择最接近真值的那个，部分掩盖了这一问题 ( Chung et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) 。 然而，这种选择使用了测试时无法获得的信息，并且不能保证所产生的样本与先验一致。 基于粒子的方法在中间时间步维持多个候选 ( Cardoso et al., 2024 ; Dou and Song, 2024 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) ，但其主要关注的是线性逆问题和粒子多样性，而非与先验一致的采样。

paragraphs.en: To address this issue, we introduce Prior-Consistent DAPS (PC-DAPS), which moves sample selection inside the sampler and removes the need for ground-truth-based best-of- k k evaluation. PC-DAPS maintains a bag of K K particles annealed under the same measurement, and models the denoiser posterior p ⁡ ( x 0 ∣ x t ) p(x_{0}\mid x_{t}) with a K K -component Gaussian mixture rather than a unimodal estimate. Early in sampling, multiple candidates are kept while the noise level is high and the prior is still weakly informative. As the noise decreases during annealing, particles with low prior consistency are pruned and replaced by surviving candidates that are more prior-consistent. PC-DAPS thus delays mode selection until the prior becomes more informative, performing within a single sampling run (and without ground-truth access) what best-of- k k does only after k k independent sampling runs.

paragraphs.en: Particle-based posterior sampling. Another group of approaches maintains many particles throughout sampling, and uses sequential Monte Carlo to propagate, reweight, and resample particles to progressively improve measurement consistency ( Cardoso et al., 2024 ; Janati et al., 2025 ) . FPS-SMC ( Dou and Song, 2024 ) casts the reverse sampling process as a state-space model and applies a particle filter. TDS ( Wu et al., 2023 ) uses twisting functions to obtain asymptotic exactness for general measurement models. While particle-based methods are typically concerned with the fidelity of the ensemble in the limit of many particles, we are concerned instead with the probability that a single returned reconstruction is prior-inconsistent, and use particles for the purpose of exploring the posterior landscape.

paragraphs.en: Diagnosing hallucination and prior misfit. Hallucination has been studied as a property of reconstruction algorithms in inverse problems since before diffusion priors were adopted ( Bhadra et al., 2021 ) , and refers to any reconstruction that is inconsistent with either the measurement or the prior. Recent work has sought to quantify hallucination specifically for diffusion-based solvers ( Jin et al., 2026 ) . At the level of the model rather than the individual sample, DiME ( Wang and Bouman, 2026 ) estimates the evidence of a diffusion prior by integrating over the time-marginals of a posterior sampler, and can be run alongside DAPS to detect prior misfit. Closest to our framing, Burns and Fridovich-Keil (2026) adopt a finite-sample perspective on reverse diffusion dynamics and show that widely used guidance approximations misestimate posterior spread at intermediate noise levels. This misestimation produces both prior modes absent from the true posterior and likelihood (measurement-consistent) modes unsupported by the prior, which is the specific failure that our PC-DAPS method aims to address. Benchmarks whose posteriors are analytically tractable provide a complementary check on the uncertainty a solver reports ( Crafts and Villa, 2025 ; Zach et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) . All of these existing hallucination diagnostics are applied after sampling; PC-DAPS utilizes prior support during sampling to decide which reconstructions survive, thereby reducing the incidence of prior-inconsistent hallucinations.
paragraphs.zh: 诊断幻觉与先验失配。 幻觉作为逆问题中重建算法的一种属性，在扩散先验被采用之前就已被研究（Bhadra et al., 2021），它指任何与测量或先验不一致的重建结果。 近期工作试图专门针对基于扩散的求解器来量化幻觉（Jin et al., 2026）。 在模型层面而非单个样本层面，DiME（Wang and Bouman, 2026）通过对后验采样器的时间边缘分布进行积分来估计扩散先验的证据，并可与 DAPS 并行运行以检测先验失配。 与我们的框架最接近的是，Burns 和 Fridovich-Keil（2026）从有限样本视角研究反向扩散动力学，并表明广泛使用的引导近似在中间噪声水平上会错误估计后验散布。 这种错误估计既会产生真实后验中不存在的先验模式，也会产生缺乏先验支持的似然（测量一致）模式，而这正是我们的 PC-DAPS 方法旨在解决的具体失效问题。 后验可解析求解的基准为求解器报告的不确定性提供了一种补充检验手段（Crafts and Villa, 2025；Zach et al., 2026；Zheng et al., 2025）。 所有这些现有的幻觉诊断方法都是在采样之后应用的；而 PC-DAPS 则在采样过程中利用先验支撑来决定哪些重建结果得以保留，从而减少先验不一致的幻觉的发生。

paragraphs.en: For example, in Fourier phase retrieval, two images which are identical up to rotation, translation, and/or color channel sign appear visually quite distinct but produce identical Fourier magnitude measurements ( Fienup, 1982 ) . On structured face images, a solver can return a 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} -rotated or color-inverted (e.g., blue) face that fits the observed Fourier measurement despite being inconsistent with a prior distribution supported only on the set of upright faces. We refer to such reconstructions as prior-inconsistent . Prior-inconsistent reconstructions commonly appear across classical phase-retrieval methods ( Fienup, 1982 ) , deep-learning approaches ( Metzler et al., 2018 ; Işil and Oktem, 2025 ) , and diffusion-based inverse-problem solvers ( Xu and Chi, 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Our goal is to reduce the frequency of prior-inconsistent solutions while retaining quality and diversity of measurement- and prior-consistent samples.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，在傅里叶相位恢复中，两幅仅在旋转、平移和/或颜色通道符号上不同而其余相同的图像在视觉上差异明显，却会产生完全相同的傅里叶幅度测量值（Fienup, 1982）。 在结构化人脸图像上，求解器可能返回一幅旋转了 180^{\circ} 或颜色反转（例如蓝色）的人脸，它虽然符合观测到的傅里叶测量值，却与仅支持于直立人脸集合上的先验分布不一致。 我们将这类重建称为先验不一致（prior-inconsistent）。 先验不一致的重建普遍出现在经典相位恢复方法（Fienup, 1982）、深度学习方法（Metzler et al., 2018；Işil and Oktem, 2025）以及基于扩散的逆问题求解器（Xu and Chi, 2024；Zhang et al., 2025）中。 我们的目标是在保持测量一致与先验一致样本的质量和多样性的同时，降低先验不一致解出现的频率。

paragraphs.en: To develop a sampler which produces fewer prior-inconsistent samples, we build on existing approaches by (i) identifying the root causes that produce the inconsistent samples and (ii) making adjustments to reduce the incidence of these samples. Specifically, we build on DAPS ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , a diffusion-based variable-splitting approach which repeatedly (i) denoises to a clean image via the reverse diffusion process, (ii) improves the clean image’s likelihood consistency via MCMC (e.g., Langevin dynamics ( Roberts and Tweedie, 1996 ) ), and (iii) renoises the MCMC output via the forward diffusion process. By adding less noise back than was originally present, DAPS aims to iteratively denoise towards a measurement-consistent clean sample.
paragraphs.zh: 为了开发一种能产生更少与先验不一致样本的采样器，我们在已有方法的基础上进行改进：（i）找出产生不一致样本的根本原因，（ii）做出调整以减少这类样本的出现。 具体而言，我们在 DAPS（Zhang 等，2025）的基础上进行构建，这是一种基于扩散的变量拆分方法，它反复执行以下步骤：（i）通过反向扩散过程对噪声图像去噪得到干净图像，（ii）通过 MCMC（如 Langevin 动力学（Roberts 和 Tweedie，1996））提升干净图像的似然一致性，（iii）通过前向扩散过程对 MCMC 输出重新加噪。 通过加回比原有噪声更少的噪声，DAPS 旨在迭代地去噪，最终得到与测量一致的干净样本。

sents.en: We refer to this phenomenon as premature mode selection because the sample x t x_{t} prematurely commits to only sampling x 0 x_{0} from a particular prior mode, without being able to adequately decommit even if that prior mode is not present in the posterior.
sents.zh: 我们将这一现象称为过早模式选择，因为样本 x_t 过早地承诺仅从某个特定的先验模式中采样 x₀，而即使该先验模式并不存在于后验中，也无法充分地解除这一承诺。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 illustrates this phenomenon. paragraphs.en: To address the presence of prior-inconsistent samples, a first approach might be to produce multiple samples via DAPS and discard any which are prior-inconsistent. paragraphs.en: To address these issues, we introduce PC-DAPS, a procedure for correcting prematurely committed particles during the sampling process without requiring access to the ground truth image or to any pre-trained prior-inconsistency classifier. PC-DAPS maintains a bag of K K particles, each of which is denoised using the same annealing schedule and pretrained denoiser, but uses different initializations and random noise in its Langevin and renoising updates. If no additional modifications are made to DAPS, the K K particles will denoise independently, and can be partitioned into (nonempty) sets of “bad” prematurely committed particles and “good” particles that are posterior-consistent. The core idea of PC-DAPS is to improve DAPS’s existing renoising strategy by identifying prematurely committed particles during sampling and moving them to more promising modes discovered by other particles in the bag. Additionally, PC-DAPS utilizes the particles to refine additional design decisions made by DAPS, such as by replacing the unimodal Gaussian approximation to the denoising distribution with an adaptive Gaussian mixture model (GMM) approximation. A toy example illustrating the benefit of this Gaussian mixture approximation is shown in Section A.3 .

paragraphs.en: What remains is to describe how PC-DAPS (i) identifies when particles commit prematurely, (ii) identifies which particles are problematic, (iii) corrects the identified particles, and (iv) constructs the multimodal denoising distribution approximation from the bag. PC-DAPS makes two core changes to DAPS, utilizing K K particles annealed in parallel: a pruning technique to correct particles trapped in prior-inconsistent likelihood modes in tasks with likelihood ambiguity ( Section 4.1 ), and a multimodal denoising distribution approximation estimated from the diversity of the particles ( Section 4.2 ). Additional implementation details and ablations are provided in Section A.4 , such as omitting the final Langevin refinement and adaptive ODE stepping from high to low noise to improve reconstruction quality while reducing computational cost ( Section A.5 ). The full algorithm ( Algorithm 1 ) can be found in Section A.1 .

paragraphs.en: On FFHQ, PC-DAPS lowers the rate of upside-down or color-inverted reconstructions from 14.5 % 14.5\% to 1.5 % 1.5\% and raises the rate of faithful reconstructions from 79.5 % 79.5\% to 97.5 % 97.5\% . paragraphs.en: Results in the diffusion literature for ambiguous inverse problems are usually reported as best-of- k k , with selection using the ground truth. This evaluation approach became common because existing solvers are inconsistent across runs, and a single-sample result would have large variations in quality. We see this instability as a symptom of premature mode selection in the context of measurement ambiguity. We introduce PC-DAPS to utilize the learned prior information to reduce this unwanted variance during sampling without the need for a ground-truth reference. Even in high-dimensional datasets, including FFHQ, our method demonstrates significant improvements due to the local structure of the prior. PC-DAPS obtains a smaller improvement on more structurally diverse datasets, namely ImageNet, because the prior landscape is more complex, exposing a remaining limitation and open problem to be addressed. We encourage future work to further explore our proposed paradigm of leveraging the prior score to assess candidate reconstructions at inference time, and work towards eliminating prior-inconsistent reconstructions even under less-structured priors.

sents.en: We introduce PC-DAPS to utilize the learned prior information to reduce this unwanted variance during sampling without the need for a ground-truth reference.
sents.zh: 我们提出 PC-DAPS，利用学习到的先验信息在采样过程中减少这种不希望的方差，而无需真实值参考。

sents.en: Even in high-dimensional datasets, including FFHQ, our method demonstrates significant improvements due to the local structure of the prior.
sents.zh: 即使在高维数据集（包括 FFHQ）上，由于先验的局部结构，我们的方法也展现出显著的改进。

sents.en: PC-DAPS obtains a smaller improvement on more structurally diverse datasets, namely ImageNet, because the prior landscape is more complex, exposing a remaining limitation and open problem to be addressed.
sents.zh: PC-DAPS 在结构更多样的数据集（即 ImageNet）上获得的改进较小，因为先验景观更为复杂，这暴露了一个尚待解决的局限性和开放问题。

sents.en: We encourage future work to further explore our proposed paradigm of leveraging the prior score to assess candidate reconstructions at inference time, and work towards eliminating prior-inconsistent reconstructions even under less-structured priors.
sents.zh: 我们鼓励未来的工作进一步探索我们提出的范式，即在推理时利用先验分数评估候选重建结果，并致力于即使在结构化程度较低的先验下也能消除与先验不一致的重建结果。

paragraphs.en: Standard metrics like PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS measure how similar a generated image is to a single reference image. Observe that these evaluation metrics penalize methods that find several plausible solutions that are equally valid under the measurement and prior if the solutions are dissimilar from the fixed reference. Because sample diversity and likelihood consistency are explicit goals of posterior sampling, including in applications such as uncertainty quantification, these sample-quality metrics are not adequate replacements for quality of the sampled posterior. In our work, we report a separate axis of reconstruction quality: prior consistency. We believe this or similar multifaceted metrics should be considered alongside standard fidelity metrics.
paragraphs.zh: PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 等标准指标衡量生成图像与单一参考图像的相似程度。 可以观察到，这些评估指标会惩罚那些找到多个同样合理且在度量与先验下同样有效、但与固定参考不相似的解的方法。 由于样本多样性与似然一致性是后验采样（包括不确定性量化等应用）的明确目标，这些样本质量指标并不足以替代被采样后验的质量。 在我们的工作中，我们报告重建质量的另一个独立维度：先验一致性。 我们认为，应将此指标或类似的多维度指标与标准保真度指标一并考量。

paragraphs.en: To compute the DAPS clean estimate x ^ 0 ​ ( x t i ) \hat{x}_{0}(x_{t_{i}}) , the probability flow ODE is integrated using Euler steps. One Euler step is used at high noise levels, where the clean estimate is less sensitive to the precise ODE integration, and this is increased to five steps at lower noise levels, where the prior becomes more discriminative and finer integration reduces discretization error near the data manifold. Since PC-DAPS utilizes a bag of multiple particles, reducing unnecessary ODE evaluations is important for controlling the additional computational cost. Adaptive ODE stepping is therefore used to improve the time efficiency of the particle-based sampler.

sents.en: One Euler step is used at high noise levels, where the clean estimate is less sensitive to the precise ODE integration, and this is increased to five steps at lower noise levels, where the prior becomes more discriminative and finer integration reduces discretization error near the data manifold.
sents.zh: 在高噪声水平下使用一个欧拉步骤，此时干净估计对精确的 ODE 积分不太敏感；在较低噪声水平下增加到五个步骤，此时先验变得更具判别性，更精细的积分可减少数据流形附近的离散化误差。

sents.en: Since PC-DAPS utilizes a bag of multiple particles, reducing unnecessary ODE evaluations is important for controlling the additional computational cost.
sents.zh: 由于 PC-DAPS 利用由多个粒子组成的粒子集合，减少不必要的 ODE 求值对于控制额外的计算成本非常重要。

sents.en: Adaptive ODE stepping is therefore used to improve the time efficiency of the particle-based sampler.
sents.zh: 因此采用自适应 ODE 步长来提高基于粒子的采样器的时间效率。

paragraphs.en: Ablations of the main computational parameters and their comparisons are presented in the following paragraphs.
paragraphs.zh: 主要计算参数的消融实验及其比较将在以下段落中呈现。

paragraphs.en: PC-DAPS benefits from the same implementation improvements identified in DAPS. The effects of the number of ODE steps used to compute the clean estimate and the number of annealing noise-scheduling steps are ablated, and trends consistent with those reported for DAPS are observed: increasing the number of ODE steps generally improves perceptual quality, while denser annealing schedules are particularly beneficial for nonlinear inverse problems. The corresponding ablations are shown in Figure 5 and Figure 6 .
paragraphs.zh: PC-DAPS 受益于在 DAPS 中发现的相同实现改进。 对用于计算干净估计的 ODE 步数以及退火噪声调度步数的影响进行了消融实验，观察到与 DAPS 中所报告的一致的趋势：增加 ODE 步数通常能提升感知质量，而更密集的退火调度对非线性逆问题尤为有益。 相应的消融实验结果如图 5 和图 6 所示。

paragraphs.en: Using more particles provides the selection procedure with more candidate trajectories, which improves its ability to distinguish distinct modes and reject prior-inconsistent but measurement-consistent components. On phase retrieval, increasing the bag size substantially improves both PSNR and LPIPS, with the gains becoming smaller beyond K = 8 K=8 – 16 16 . This improvement comes at an approximately linear increase in computational cost, since all K K particles are propagated through the annealing schedule. Compared with DAPS best-of- k k , PC-DAPS achieves higher reconstruction quality while using less sampling time for larger bag sizes, as shown in Figure 7 .
paragraphs.zh: 使用更多粒子能为选择步骤提供更多候选轨迹，从而提升其区分不同模式并剔除与先验不一致但与观测一致的成分的能力。 在相位恢复任务上，增大包的大小能显著提升 PSNR 和 LPIPS，但当 K=8–16 之后增益逐渐变小。 这一提升以大约线性的计算成本增长为代价，因为所有 K 个粒子都要经过整个退火调度进行传播。 如图 7 所示，与 DAPS best-of-k 相比，PC-DAPS 在较大包尺寸下以更少的采样时间实现了更高的重建质量。

paragraphs.en: The implementation choices in Section A.4 , such as skipping the final Langevin refinement and using adaptive ODE steps at low noise, help lower the sampling cost of PC-DAPS. Figure 8 shows the measured wall-clock time and reconstruction quality. For super-resolution, PC-DAPS takes longer than DAPS because it uses multiple particles. For phase retrieval, though, the DAPS runtime includes four separate runs because it uses a best-of-4 evaluation protocol. PC-DAPS, on the other hand, creates the particle set in one run and selects internally. These results suggest that using multiple particles does not always mean a much higher wall-clock cost to achieve the same quality metric.

paragraphs.en: Unless otherwise specified, PC-DAPS uses the 1 1 K setting with 200 annealing steps and adaptive ODE stepping, and generates K = 4 K=4 reconstructions for each measurement. Reported PC-DAPS metrics are averaged over the four reconstructions. For phase retrieval, baselines other than PC-DAPS are evaluated using the best of four independent runs, selecting the reconstruction closest to the ground-truth image, following prior work ( Chung et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . This protocol gives the baselines access to ground-truth information that is unavailable to PC-DAPS at test time. PSNR, SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) are reported in Table 1 for all methods. For ablation studies, the PC-DAPS variants follow the corresponding DAPS settings reported in Table 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 除非另有说明，PC-DAPS 使用 1 1 K 设置，即 200 步退火和自适应 ODE 步长，并为每次测量生成 K = 4 个重建结果。 报告的 PC-DAPS 指标为四个重建结果的平均值。 在相位检索任务中，除 PC-DAPS 外的基线方法按照先前工作（Chung et al., 2023；Zhang et al., 2025）的惯例，使用四次独立运行中的最佳结果进行评估，即选择最接近真实图像的重建结果。 这一协议使基线方法能够获得真实标签信息，而 PC-DAPS 在测试时无法使用这些信息。 表 1 中报告了所有方法的 PSNR、SSIM（Wang et al., 2004）和 LPIPS（Zhang et al., 2018）。 在消融研究中，PC-DAPS 的各变体遵循表 5 中报告的相应 DAPS 设置。
